hero.subtitle: Experience the harmony of traditional Vietnamese cuisine in our lush, bamboo-inspired sanctuary. A journey for all your senses.

about.title: A Sanctuary of Bamboo & Culinary Art
about.p1: Founded on the principles of sustainability and authentic flavor, Bamboo House is more than just a restaurant. It's a botanical escape designed to reconnect you with the earth's natural beauty.
about.p2: Our architecture utilizes sustainable bamboo, creating a breathable, organic space that complements our farm-to-table philosophy. Every dish is a tribute to the rich culinary heritage of Vietnam.
about.quote: "The most beautiful dining space I've ever experienced."
